segments.text: THou art desired both to excuse the mis-spellings, mis-pointings, transposings and obscure impressions of several words, especially in the Marginal notes. And to understand, that for brevity sake I have used these marks; for To wit, viz.: for that is, i. e.; for as if he should say, q. d.: And lastly, before thou readest to Correct these more gross mistakes, in which thou wilt do right both to thy self and the Author.
